import os,json,subprocess,shutil
from pathlib import Path
home=Path.home()
def read(p):
 try: return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
 except Exception: return None
ps="Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -match \"git-sync|jev|dsh|hermes\" } | Select-Object TaskName,TaskPath,State,@{N=\"Actions\";E={@($_.Actions | Select-Object Execute,Arguments)}},@{N=\"Limit\";E={$_.Settings.ExecutionTimeLimit}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5"
r=subprocess.run(["powershell","-NoProfile","-Command",ps],capture_output=True,timeout=25)
print(json.dumps({"host":os.environ.get("COMPUTERNAME"),"python":__import__("sys").executable,"tools":{x:shutil.which(x) for x in ["node","npm","dsh","hermes"]},"hub":read(home/".git-sync-hub"/"hub-state.json"),"tasks":r.stdout.decode("utf-8","replace"),"task_error":r.stderr.decode("utf-8","replace"),"e_dirs":[p.name for p in Path("E:/").iterdir() if p.is_dir() and any(s in p.name.lower() for s in ["dsh","hermes","apps","node"])],"result_dirs":[p.name for p in Path("E:/0github/results").iterdir() if p.is_dir()]},ensure_ascii=True))
